title: Demographics of Japan
extract: The demography of Japan is monitored by the National Institute of Population and Social Security Research (IPSS) and Statistics Bureau. In April 2025, Japan's population was roughly 123.4 million people, and peaked at 128.5 million people in 2010. It is the 6th-most populous country in Asia, and the 12th-most populous country in the world.
